Full summary: Merged lane/05-verification into foundation/v3; merged the two README claims on test/acceptance/cases/ and fixed the switchboard fixture, whose agentB-authored rivals were rejected as unauthenticated author assertions.
Decisions: [object Object]; Merged the two competing test/acceptance/cases/README.md claims (lane 04's conformance mapping and scoring rules, lane 05's ownership rules and blocker table) into one file rather than choosing a side, and updated the blocker table to post-merge truth: C03 is lane 04's and C27 is lane 03's per DN26, leaving C13, C23 and C28 as the honest remaining stubs
Findings: author_assertion_not_authenticated is emitted by src/events/event-store.ts checkCredential but is not yet in REJECT_REASONS in src/contracts/delivery.ts — it is one of the draft.3 additions still to apply.; The switchboard's N-CONFLICT control was silently vacuous-adjacent before this: it reported a projection defect (superseded instead of conflicted) when the real cause was that half the fixture never got admitted. A control that fails for the wrong reason is as misleading as one that cannot fail.
